description: Defines the ue_cell_repository class, which manages UEs within a cell, including storage, lookup, and management of UE-related data structures and operations.

classes.name: ue_cell_repository
classes.description: Repository managing UEs in a specific cell, providing methods for adding, removing, and querying UEs, as well as managing related resources like HARQ processes and power controllers.

methods.name: ue_cell_repository
methods.description: Constructor initializing the repository with cell configuration and metrics handler.

methods.name: cell_index
methods.description: Returns the index of the cell.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a UE or RNTI is contained in the repository.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of UEs in the repository.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the repository is empty.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to the beginning of the UEs.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator to the end of the UEs.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses a UE by its index.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds a UE by its index.

methods.name: find_by_rnti
methods.description: Finds a UE by its RNTI.

methods.name: get_cell_harqs
methods.description: Returns the HARQ manager for the cell.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Updates the last processed slot for the cell.

methods.name: deactivate
methods.description: Stops all UE-related operations in the repository.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE to the repository.

methods.name: rem_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from the repository.
